Bash(node -e "require\('dotenv'\).config\(\); const k=process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY||''; console.log\('loaded length:', k.length\); console.log\('masked:', k.slice\(0,8\)+'...'+k.slice\(-4\)\); console.log\('looks valid:', k.startsWith\('sk-'\) && !k.includes\('your_'\)\);")

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3001/api/webhook/twilio/voice" -Method POST -ContentType "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -Body "CallSid=CAtest123&From=%2B15551234567&To=%2B15559876543&CallStatus=ringing" -UseBasicParsing 2>&1 | Select-Object StatusCode, StatusDescription, Content)

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://ranger-modify-keep-rain.trycloudflare.com/api/webhook/twilio/voice" -Method POST -ContentType "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -Body "CallSid=CAtest&From=%2B15551234567" -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($r\) { "Status: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; $r.Content } else { "Failed to reach tunnel" })

Bash(node -e "require\('dotenv'\).config\(\); const p = process.env.USER_PHONE_NUMBER; console.log\('USER_PHONE_NUMBER raw:', JSON.stringify\(p\)\); console.log\('length:', \(p||''\).length\); console.log\('Is E.164:', /^\\+\\d{10,15}$/.test\(p||''\)\); console.log\('TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID set:', !!process.env.TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID\); console.log\('TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN set:', !!process.env.TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN\);")

Bash(node -e "require\('dotenv'\).config\(\); console.log\('TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER:', JSON.stringify\(process.env.TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER\)\); console.log\('TWILIO_NUMBER:', JSON.stringify\(process.env.TWILIO_NUMBER\)\); console.log\('PUBLIC_URL:', JSON.stringify\(process.env.PUBLIC_URL\)\); console.log\('All TWILIO/PHONE keys:', Object.keys\(process.env\).filter\(k=>/TWILIO|PHONE|URL|TUNNEL/i.test\(k\)\)\);")
